complaint: I forgot my password and can't log in.
response: To reset your forgotten password, please go to the sign-in (login) page and select the "Forgot password?" option. Enter your registered email address, and a password reset code will be sent to that email. The code expires in 30 minutes. Use the code to set a new password with at least 12 characters. Please do not share the reset code with anyone, including support agents. If you need further help, feel free to ask.

complaint: I want to return the shoes I bought last week. How do I get a refund?
response: You can return your shoes by initiating the return through your orders dashboard. Please ensure the shoes are unworn, unwashed, with brand tags intact and in the original packaging, as these conditions are required for a return within the 14-day window. Once your return is verified, you can receive a refund to your original payment source, a wallet refund, or opt for a size or color exchange. If the shoes are damaged or defective, please provide photographs during the return process for verification.
